clips.title: The story
paras: Skuerto is a dwarven scout stationed at Refuge Pointe in the Arathi Highlands. Sent there by Archmage Malin alongside Apprentice Kryten, he aids the Alliance in the field, helping secure magical relics on Malin's behalf.

Skuerto, a dwarf of Ironforge, works as a scout in the dangerous Arathi Highlands. Stationed alongside Apprentice Kryten at Refuge Pointe, he works under the direction of Archmage Malin to recover arcane reagents and potent magical artifacts that once belonged to Malin's old master, Archmage Trelane.

Despite the harsh conditions of the Highlands, Skuerto takes considerable pride in his wilderness scouting and reacts poorly to anyone questioning his competence. His work regularly brushes up against regional perils, from the hostile Syndicate and Boulderfist ogres to dangerous ancient entities tied to the land.
